import json

# Tragedy of the commons requires both:
#  (1) each actor pursues private gain by taking more of a shared resource/action,
#  (2) the cost is spread over all actors (an externality), leaving everyone worse off.
# Features below are read from each option's text.
options = {
    "A": {"private_gain": True,  "shared_cost": True,  "note": "arms race: each side builds up, all lose security"},
    "B": {"private_gain": False, "shared_cost": False, "note": "zero-sum win/lose game: one side's gain is the other's loss, no shared resource degraded"},
    "C": {"private_gain": True,  "shared_cost": True,  "note": "classic overgrazing of a public pasture"},
    "D": {"private_gain": True,  "shared_cost": True,  "note": "firms dump pollution into shared water and air"},
}

not_tragedy = [k for k, v in options.items() if not (v["private_gain"] and v["shared_cost"])]

result = {
    "final_answer": not_tragedy[0] if len(not_tragedy) == 1 else "UNSUPPORTED",
    "evidence": {k: (v["private_gain"] and v["shared_cost"]) for k, v in options.items()},
}
print(json.dumps(result))
